changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: UPDATE rbac_setting SET data = jsonb_set(data::jsonb, '{visibleRoles}', (data::jsonb -> 'visibleRoles') || '"officer"'::jsonb)::text WHERE kind = 'menus' AND id = 'advanced-map' AND jsonb_typeof(data::jsonb -> 'visibleRoles') = 'array' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(data::jsonb -> 'visibleRoles') AS role(value) WHERE role.value = 'officer' );
